h1: Custom Reflective T Shirts for Safety & Visibility
metaTitle: Custom Reflective T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom reflective t shirts for high-visibility branding. Perfect for safety teams, events, and night crews. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom reflective t shirts combine everyday comfort with high-visibility safety, making them ideal for construction crews, event staff, and nighttime runners. Unlike standard tees, these shirts feature reflective strips or prints that bounce back light, keeping your team visible in low-light conditions. Choose from front-and-back screen printing or embroidery on the reflective panels for a durable brand impression that works around the clock.
heroAltText: Group of workers wearing custom reflective t shirts with printed logos, standing on a construction site at dusk
